note: Line-split marker of the save list (0x80015BB0): line 1 = title up to and including the first match (x 0x32), line 2 = the rest (x 0x7A, 14 px lower). JP splits after 』 (episode | battle/castle part). If there is no match line 1 is not drawn and the whole title goes on line 2. E0066 ', %s Turn %2d', E0067 ', %s HQ' and E0483 ', in %s' start with ', ' for this split (0.2.4). No ', ' occurs in E0008-E0035 or E0065. [proof: note]
Clan name: save title ' %s HQ' (E0067, table 0x800BE860) and the clan column (table 0x800F9DE4).

Castle part of the save title (sprintf at 0x80016388, %s = DATA castle name: Koriyama, Ogura, ... Kyoto, Azuchi), appended right after the episode title. ', ' is the line-split marker E0474, so line 2 reads 'in Koriyama'. 'Castle' is left out: 24 px limit, and 'Kyoto Castle' would be wrong.
Digit table 0x800BE87C used by the save-number formatter 0x800166FC (entry 10 = '' for leading zeros).
Particle %s of E0097 (0x80124194) and E0216 (0x8012466C), chosen when the storehouse still has room (s3 = 1 at 0x800183E8 / 0x8003B844): 'Move items to the Storehouse?'.
Level-up / item screen: old value -> new value (puts at 0x800186BC).
Settings screen label (table 0x800DC200); values On / Off (E0112/E0113).
